title: Don't change your internet plan before reading this
text: Don’t change your internet plan before reading this A faster internet plan might be a waste without changing your router first A faster internet plan might be a waste without changing your router first This content is reviewed by the 7NEWS Editorial team. 7NEWS may receive a commission when you buy from links on our site. Prices correct at time of publication. On top of the various tech deals, there are also great deals on internet plans that promise faster speeds and more reliable connections. If your router cant handle or make the most of the upgraded connection then a faster plan might not make a difference. Research by Opensignal showed that using a router with newer Wi-Fi generations can sometimes double the speeds experienced in your home compared to older models.The eero Pro 7 isn’t just about delivering fast speeds but also better bandwidth. An out-of-date router is a common bottleneck with the report by Opensignal showing that 64 per cent of those surveyed were using older Wi-Fi generations that aren’t capable of delivering the types of speeds that the NBN offers.Research showed that 26 per cent of customers who paid for 500Mbps download speeds had routers using Wi-Fi 4 which is only capable of up to 100Mbps.the eero Pro 7 and says : “The signal is strong and without gaps throughout the house.
